summary: No Putumayo-specific finding on the treatment of trans visitors or residents was identified in the sources reviewed. The department stands under Colombia's national legal and protection framework, and the national assessment applies.
tangentialFactors:
The reporting reviewed for this pass is national in scope or located in other departments: the April 2025 killing of Sara Millerey in Bello, Antioquia, and armed-group threat campaigns documented in Caquetá. Neither source places an incident, a threat campaign, an official statement or an enforcement action in Putumayo, and that material is carried by the national record.

No authority in Putumayo, departmental or municipal, issued a statement, decree or enforcement action concerning trans residents or visitors in the sources reviewed.
localsOnly: No Putumayo-specific information on residents was identified: no departmental health, education, prison or employment data, and no local reporting on how trans residents of the department obtain identity documents, medical care or work.
outOfScopeNotes: Unresolved: whether the armed-group threats and displacement documented elsewhere in Colombia extend into Putumayo is not sourced in the material reviewed. No departmental breakdown of anti-trans violence statistics for Putumayo was located, and no municipal ordinances or police protocols specific to the department were found.
